initial.name: bash
initial.description: Execute a foreground bash command and return stdout, stderr and exit status. Each call starts a fresh shell; use workdir to choose a directory within /workspace. Output may be truncated. Provide description before command.

description.description: Concise active-voice description of the command.

timeoutMs.description: Command deadline in milliseconds, 1–60000. Default 30000; the process is stopped on expiry.
